This grabs data

Last data pull initated on 9/1/2026

# Set up environment

```{r}
#| label: setup-env
# Load in packages
if (!require("pacman")) {
  install.packages("pacman")
}
pacman::p_load(httr, jsonlite, tidyverse, here, data.table)

# Clear envionrment
rm(list = ls())

# Set working directory
here::i_am("scripts/L3/302_retrieve_updated_obs.qmd")

# Point to directories
L3_data_dir <- here("data", "L3") # L3 data
L301_data_dir <- here(L3_data_dir, "301_api_uploads")
```

# Read data to retrieve

```{r}
#| label: read-data
obs_to_retrieve <- readRDS(here(
  L301_data_dir,
  "301b_ETF_EPT_IDS_api_uploads.rds"
)) |>
  filter(posted_to_inat == TRUE)

target_ids <- unique(na.omit(obs_to_retrieve$observation_id))
```

# Establish API parameters

```{r}
#| label: est-api-param
# base API url
API_URL <- "https://api.inaturalist.org/v1/observations"
PER_PAGE <- 200 # Max records per request (API maximum)
USER_NAME <- "iNat user: kmtorres" # allows iNat to reach out about API traffic concerns

id_chunks <- split(target_ids, ceiling(seq_along(target_ids) / PER_PAGE))
total_batches <- length(id_chunks)
```

# Retrieve data from API

## Check existing data

Observation data was pulled between November 3rd and 4th 2025 for EPT taxa.
However, the study period is from 2000-2025, so additional data needs to be
pulled to complete the period.


## Retrieve new data

```{r}
#| label: retrieve-api-data
# Directory to save raw chunks safely
cache_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "inat_batches")
if (!dir.exists(cache_dir)) {
  dir.create(cache_dir)
}

batch_list <- vector("list", length = total_batches)

cat(sprintf(
  "Starting download for %d observations across %d batches...\n\n",
  length(target_ids),
  total_batches
))
# 2. Retrieve data in batches
for (i in seq_along(id_chunks)) {
  current_ids <- id_chunks[[i]]
  id_param <- paste(current_ids, collapse = ",")

  params <- list(
    id = id_param,
    per_page = PER_PAGE
  )

  response <- GET(API_URL, query = params, user_agent(USER_NAME))

  if (http_error(response)) {
    warning(sprintf(
      "HTTP Error on batch %d/%d: %s",
      i,
      total_batches,
      http_status(response)$message
    ))
    Sys.sleep(2)
    next
  }

  raw_text <- content(response, "text", encoding = "UTF-8")
  parsed <- fromJSON(raw_text, simplifyVector = FALSE)

  if (!is.null(parsed$results) && length(parsed$results) > 0) {
    # Clean every row into a named list with 100% consistent character types
    rows_cleaned <- lapply(parsed$results, function(obs) {
      lapply(obs, function(val) {
        if (is.null(val) || length(val) == 0) {
          return(NA_character_)
        }
        if (is.list(val) || length(val) > 1) {
          return(as.character(toJSON(val, auto_unbox = TRUE)))
        }
        return(as.character(val))
      })
    })

    # Fast, crash-proof bind per batch
    batch_list[[i]] <- rbindlist(rows_cleaned, fill = TRUE, use.names = TRUE)

    cat(sprintf(
      "Batch %d/%d: Retrieved %d records.\n",
      i,
      total_batches,
      length(rows_cleaned)
    ))
  } else {
    cat(sprintf("Batch %d/%d: No records returned.\n", i, total_batches))
  }

  Sys.sleep(1.2)
}

# 3. Combine all batches into the final data frame
final_obs_df <- as.data.frame(rbindlist(
  batch_list,
  fill = TRUE,
  use.names = TRUE
))

cat(sprintf(
  "\nComplete! Successfully retrieved %d observations across %d fields without errors.\n",
  nrow(final_obs_df),
  ncol(final_obs_df)
))
```

# Save data and file

> [!IMPORTANT]
> This will write over the existing files by joining the existing data with new data if the API found new observation records

```{r}
#| label: export-data
saveRDS(final_obs_df, here(L3_data_dir, "302_updated_obs.rds"))
write_csv(final_obs_df, here(L3_data_dir, "302_updated_obs.csv"))
```


```{r}
extracted_obs <- unique(final_obs_df$id)

all_obs <- unique(obs_to_retrieve$observation_id)

missing_obs <- setdiff(all_obs, extracted_obs)

# Check how many are missing
cat(sprintf(
  "Missing observations: %d out of %d\n",
  length(missing_obs),
  length(all_obs)
))
```
